item.text:
It provides order totals, coupon discounts, average pricing, and printable order summaries.

Bug: `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined), throwing a TypeError for every array, including empty ones ([test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:5)). Use `i < items.length`.

Consequently, `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` also fail because they call `calcTotal`.

Potential semantic issue: `averageItemPrice` divides order total by distinct line items, not total quantity; for `{price: 10, qty: 2}` it returns 20 rather than unit price 10.
